issues.title: 修复问候函数返回值
issues.body: greet.cjs 导出的 greet(name) 应返回 Hello, <name>!，例如 greet('Ada') 返回 Hello, Ada!。保留 CommonJS 导出。

args: const assert = require('node:assert/strict'); const greet = require('./greet.cjs'); assert.equal(greet('Ada'), 'Hello, Ada!'); assert.equal(greet('Lin'), 'Hello, Lin!');
